name: Oberlochalm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Oberlochalm in Tirol!**

Nestled high in the **Tiroler Alps**, the **Oberlochalm** is a true paradise for nature lovers, hikers, and families. Enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the **Zillertal Alps** and the **Karkopf** from this sunny alpine meadow at **2,000 meters** above sea level.

### **A Year-Round Adventure**
In **winter**, the **Oberlochalm** transforms into a snowy playground with well-groomed trails for **skiing**, **snowboarding**, and **cross-country skiing**. The **Zillertal Arena** offers top-class slopes for all skill levels, while the **Oberlochalm** area provides a peaceful retreat with stunning alpine scenery.

In **summer**, the **Oberlochalm** is a haven for hikers and mountain bikers. Explore the **Alpenrosenweg** (Alpine Rose Trail) or take the **Zugspitzbahn** (cable car) to the **Hahnenkamm** for unforgettable views. The **Oberlochalm** also serves as a starting point for exciting **via ferrata** routes and **mountaineering** adventures.

### **Culinary Delights & Relaxation**
After an active day, unwind at the **Oberlochalm’s** cozy **Hütte** (mountain hut). Savor traditional **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or hearty **Schmankerl** (specialties) while enjoying the fresh mountain air. The **Oberlochalm** also offers a **bar** and **terrace** with panoramic views—perfect for a refreshing **Apfelstrudel** or a cold **Tiroler Bier**.

### **Family-Friendly & Accessible**
The **Oberlochalm** is easily accessible by **cable car** from **Zell am Ziller** or **Fieberbrunn**. Families will love the **playground**, **mini-golf**, and **petting zoo**, while adults can relax in the **sauna** or enjoy a **massage** with a view.

### **Events & Celebrations**
Throughout the year, the **Oberlochalm** hosts lively events, from **Christmas markets** in winter to **open-air concerts** in summer. Don’t miss the **Almabtrieb** (alpine cattle drive) in autumn—a true **Tiroler** tradition!

### **Plan Your Visit**
- **Location:** **Oberlochalm**, **Zillertal**, **Tirol**
- **Altitude:** **2,000 m**
- **Access:** **Zugspitzbahn** (cable car) from **Zell am Ziller** or **Fieberbrunn**
- **Open:** Year-round (seasonal opening times apply)

Experience the magic of the **Oberlochalm**—where adventure meets relaxation in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**!
